slides.say: Given: zero is smaller than t, which is smaller than one. Which of the following expressions is the largest?
So t is between zero and one, and we want the largest of four results. [short pause] We'll solve it two ways, using the operation rules, and then choosing a number with an easy sixth root.

[short pause] Let's start with choice number three, t to the sixth. Between zero and one, increasing the power makes the result smaller: the arrow points left. The result stays positive, so t to the sixth is between zero and t.
Choice number four is the sixth root of t. Its power is one sixth, smaller than the power of one in t itself. So its result is larger than t, but still smaller than one. It is between t and one.
Choice number one is six times t. t is positive and smaller than one. Multiplying six by it gives a result smaller than six.

Choice number two is six over t. Dividing by a positive number smaller than one makes six larger, so this result is greater than six. Now compare all four: the two power and root results are below one, six times t is below six, and six over t is above six. Only choice number two is above six, so it is the largest. That's our answer.

[pause] Now let's try plugging in. Use t is one over sixty-four. One half to the sixth is one over sixty-four, so the sixth root will be easy. In each choice, replace only t. The sixes stay as they are.
Choice number one is six times one over sixty-four, which is six over sixty-four. Divide the top and bottom by two to get three over thirty-two. That is smaller than one.

Choice number two is six divided by one over sixty-four. Dividing by this fraction means multiplying by sixty-four. Six times sixty is three hundred sixty, and six times four is twenty-four. Add them to get three hundred eighty-four.

Choice number three raises the whole fraction, one over sixty-four, to the sixth power. Its result is still between zero and one. We do not need the exact number to know it is smaller than three hundred eighty-four.

Choice number four is the sixth root of one over sixty-four, which is one half. Choices one, three and four all give results below one. Choice number two gives three hundred eighty-four, so it is the largest. Choice number two is our answer. [pause] Okay. I'll see you in the next question.
